### Keshav Singh — Distribution of Flipper Length

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
# penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkorange", "purple", "cyan4")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Flipper Lengths",
       x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Species") +
  theme_minimal()
```
